title: Marketplace listing acceptance lifecycle and demo sprint guidance
summary: Compact playbook focused on the end-to-end acceptance lifecycle for new partner listings plus a 1-week demo sprint template aimed at reducing time-to-live for SMB-focused marketplace offers.
body:
Purpose:
This doc captures a practical acceptance lifecycle for vendor listings and a short, executable demo sprint to get an SMB-focused tile from assets -> published. The goal: reduce back-and-forth by standardizing acceptance gates, seller-facing copy templates, technical QA, and a demo sprint cadence for partners and internal PMs.

Audience:
- Partner PMs and partner engineering leads
- GTM launch managers and listing writers
- Solutions engineers and QA engineers who run acceptance tests

High-level approach:
1) Pre-flight: acceptance checklist owned by partner enablement (assets, billing sku, support link, security attestations).
2) Tech QA: infra & API smoke tests validated by partner engineering.
3) Listing copy + UX: a concise narrative (30–40 word tagline + 2 bullet benefits + 1 CTA) reviewed by marketing.
4) Staging preview: internal preview in marketplace sandbox with telemetry hooks.
5) Publish + monitor: release and 2-week telemetry gating for rollback if CPM/engagement or errors deviate.

What counts as "accepted":
- All mandatory asset fields present and validated (logo, short description, long description, screenshots, support contact).
- Billing SKU mapped and test purchase flow exercised in sandbox.
- Security checklist signed (SaaS or on-prem variations).
- Demo flow (see sprint) recorded and validated by solutions engineering.
- Telemetry events emitted for impressions, clicks, and provisioning success, sent to GTM analytics.

Notes on SMB-focused UX quick wins:
- Use a 1-line problem statement that maps to a single SMB job-to-be-done (e.g., "Fast, predictable LLM inference for product teams on a budget").
- Surface cost predictability: show reserved vs burst pricing callout.
- Keep screenshots to 2: pricing & onboarding steps.
- Provide a one-click trial callout with max 14-day credit.

Risks and mitigations:
- Asset mismatch (partner provides wrong resolution logos) -> mitigation: automated dimension check + asset naming convention guide.
- Billing mapping delays -> mitigation: pre-reserve temporary SKU and run smoke purchase during tech QA.
- Security docs incomplete -> mitigation: block publish until compliance owner signs off.

"Demo sprint" template (1 week) overview:
This is a focused, time-boxed lab to produce a validated demo and marketplace preview tile in 5 working days. Run with a 2–3 person core team: partner PM, solutions engineer, GTM writer.

Day 0 (pre-sprint prep)
- Gather assets and account access, confirm sandbox credentials, share acceptance checklist.

Day 1: Kickoff + copy polish
- 1h kickoff to align on target persona and success metric.
- GTM writer drafts short/long copy and CTA.

Day 2: Integrations + billing mapping
- Partner engineering validates API keys, run provisioning flow in sandbox.
- Map billing SKU and simulate purchase.

Day 3: UX & screenshot capture
- Create two annotated screenshots (pricing & onboarding).
- GTM writer iterates copy based on screenshots.

Day 4: Tech QA + telemetry
- Run smoke tests (provisioning, inference sanity, error paths).
- Verify telemetry events arrive in analytics.

Day 5: Internal preview + signoffs
- Internal review in marketplace sandbox, record a 2-minute demo video.
- Compliance and billing signoffs acquired; prepare publish checklist.

Post-publish day 1–14 monitoring
- Track conversion, error-rate, and billing errors. If provisioning success < 95% or error spikes > 2x baseline, trigger rollback and incident triage.

Asset naming and delivery conventions (minimal):
- logo_primary.png (320x320, transparent), logo_inverse.png (320x320, white bg), hero_1.png (1200x600), onboarding_step-1.png (1024x640)
- copy-short.txt (<= 40 words), copy-long.md (<= 350 words), feature-bullets.csv (3 rows)
- demo-video.mp4 (max 90s), screenshots in PNG, assets zipped following partner-name_version.zip

Sample marketplace copy (SMB-focused):
- Tagline (30–40 words): "Get consistent, low-latency LLM inference for product teams—simple pricing, predictable throughput. Start with a 14-day trial and reserve capacity as you grow."
- 2 benefit bullets: "• Fast start: deploy a validated inference path in minutes; no infra setup.
• Cost controls: reserved pools + smart batching to lower unit cost for high traffic."
- CTA: "Start free trial"

Acceptance checklist (quick):
- [ ] logos uploaded (primary and inverse)
- [ ] short + long copy approved by GTM writer
- [ ] screenshots captured and annotated
- [ ] billing SKU mapped and sandbox purchase successful
- [ ] telemetry events sending (impression, click, provision_success, provision_fail)
- [ ] security questionnaire answered and compliance owner signoff
- [ ] demo video recorded and uploaded to preview

Open questions / edge cases:
- How do we handle partner tiles that require on-prem package delivery vs hosted API? (needs additional gating for delivery terms)
- What SLAs should be surfaced on the tile for Dedicated customers? (legal + SRE input required)

References / quick links:
- Confluence: marketplace listing requirements (linked artifact above)
- Jira: acceptance epic JIRA-5642 (linked), technical test plan JIRA-5730
- GitHub: asset repo PR #88

Next steps (owner: Ava Chen)
- Run 1 pilot sprint with 2 partners in Sep (target: reduce time-to-publish to <= 7 days).
- Capture friction points and add to this checklist.

Document history: created 2024-08-14; reviewed 2024-08-28 by Diego Morales and Priya Raman.
